statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let f := fun (x n j : ℝ) => x * Real.log (1+j/n); ∀ (X : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (H : ℝ → ℝ), 1000 ≤ X → (∀ v, 1/4 ≤ |v| → H v = 0) → (w X).sum (fun n => ((w X).filter (fun m => n < m)).sum (fun m => u n*u m*H (f X n (m-n) - 2))) = ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => u n*u (n+2)*H (f X n 2 - 2))
